title: Finite verification of thermal noise precompensation
scope: Deterministic finite algebra and finite Markov-chain verification only. No BDL asymptotic lifetime, hardware feasibility, experimental performance, or total-resource advantage is inferred.

open_chain_heatbath.tv_curve_interpretation: Transition-matrix propagation from two specified initial states, evaluated in double precision with roundoff normalization; no Monte Carlo sampling and not worst-case over all initial states.

compatible_context_example.note: High precision resolves the small nonzero soft interaction.

five_qubit_quantum_check.scope: Exact finite density-matrix algebra up to floating-point error; no holding or lifetime assertion.

independent_thermal_bits.compensated_product_tv: 0 exactly by the one-bit algebra, at every N
independent_thermal_bits.tv_method: Exact binomial-CDF likelihood-ratio cutoff, using permutation symmetry of product Bernoulli laws.
